title: Microsoft Teams Rooms and shared devices: passwordless sign-in for Entra resource accounts
summary: Hold for corrections to password cleanup guidance. Microsoft documents password-reset automation, an exception for synchronized accounts with password writeback, and restrictions on which accounts Password Administrator can reset; the briefing omits these distinctions.

claims.claim: Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Teams panels and Teams phones support passwordless resource-account migration.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms on Windows, Teams Rooms on Android, Teams panels, and Teams phones can be migrated when they meet the prerequisites in this article.

claims.where: controls[0].note; controls[2].note; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: A portal Resource Accounts editing role plus Password Administrator, User Administrator or Global Administrator permits password cleanup.
claims.quote: If the resource account has a Microsoft Entra administrative role, or is a member or owner of a role-assignable group, Password Administrator might not be able to reset its password.
claims.fix: Qualify the cleanup role statement wherever repeated: 'Cleanup requires a portal role that can edit Resource Accounts and Password Administrator, User Administrator or Global Administrator with permission to reset the target account. An administrative-unit-scoped Password Administrator can reset only nonadministrator accounts in that unit; Password Administrator might not reset accounts with an Entra administrative role or membership or ownership of a role-assignable group. Remove unnecessary privileged assignments or use an appropriate higher-privileged role.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/passwordlessentraresourceaccounts.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Teams Administrator alone does not permit resetting the resource account password.

claims.claim: Privileged Role Administrator or Global Administrator assigns the required administrative roles.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes required role assignment as a one-time Entra configuration.
claims.quote: This is a one-time role configuration in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: The portal does not support password cleanup for Teams Shared Device-licensed accounts; reset them in Entra instead.
claims.quote: Password cleanup in the portal isn't available for accounts with a Teams Shared Device license. Reset the passwords for those accounts in Microsoft Entra instead.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Migration does not remove the password from the resource account in Entra ID.
claims.quote: After a Teams device transitions to password-less authentication, its resource account password remains in Microsoft Entra ID, but the device no longer uses that password to sign in.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends cleanup or manual password rotation after migration.
claims.quote: We recommend that IT administrators use the cleanup steps or manually rotate the password after the transition to ensure that the password is unknown and secure.

claims.claim: The retained, known account password remains usable until it is reset or scrambled.
claims.quote: Cloud-based passwordless users should have their password set to a random value. Randomizing the password prevents the user from knowing the password and using it to authenticate.
claims.fix: Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/authentication/how-to-plan-password-scramble-phishing-resistant-passwordless-authentication for the continued password-usage premise, alongside the feature page's statement that the password remains in Entra ID.

claims.claim: Changing the resource account password does not sign out a migrated device.
claims.quote: If the resource account password is modified the device will remain signed in unlike prior to the transition where the device would be signed out.

claims.quote: Authentication to Microsoft 365 services (Teams, Intune, Pro Management Portal, etc) does not change.
